verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google spend is being resolved this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 128 leads at an average cost of $22.07 per lead — all of them from Meta. Google Ads ran $1,475 in spend over the same window and produced zero leads, confirmed not a tracking issue; that budget is being redirected. Meta lead volume dropped sharply in the last 7 days (-48%), which pushed cost per lead up significantly, though the last three days show a partial recovery in daily lead pace. Next period, Google's budget will be reallocated and new creative is being delivered, so Meta has stronger material to work with heading into September.
